title: Ex-Google Recruiter Explains: 6 Résumé Secrets That Get You Hired
description:
Get my Job Seekers Toolkit: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/get-my-job-seekers-toolkit-now
 Book a 1:1: https://stan.store/farahsharghi/p/book-a-1hour-career-coaching-session-with-me-eq3bs

You've applied to hundreds of jobs. Nothing. Not even a rejection email.
It's not you. It's the mistakes no one ever told you about.

As an ex-Google recruiter who's reviewed thousands of resumes and sat in countless hiring meetings, I'm exposing the 6 hidden reasons your resume gets rejected before anyone even reads it.

 You'll discover:

Why the "perfect" candidate rarely gets hired (and who does instead)
The deadly resume gaps that make recruiters create their own story about you
How using the wrong verbs instantly makes you look junior
Why your 15 years of experience might be working against you
The 3-part formula that makes any resume feel complete

Stop wondering if you're the problem. Start understanding what hiring managers actually want: someone who looks safe, sounds senior, and signals they can solve today's problems.

These aren't tips. These are the unspoken rules that get you interviews.
